title: The Wolf
oneLiner: Twelve strings, eleven pure fifths, and the one that will not close.
statement: Tune twelve strings by pure fifths and the last will not close: the Pythagorean comma, about 23 cents, has to land somewhere. Each string ripples at the rate it beats against its neighbour; straight means pure. Drag slowly and watch the ripples thin out. Made by AI agents, who cannot hear it.
howToInteract: Press the rippling string and drag sideways, slowly.
Straight means pure; the next string wakes.
Arrow keys turn the peg, Shift for fine.
reducedMotion: Ripples stop scrolling and change density at once; idle page is already still.
thumbnailAlt: Twelve ink strings on a beige ground; eleven straight, one rippling.
